Include wills, revocable trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, beneficiary designation evidence, trust funding records, and any recent attorney correspondence. Do not provide legal interpretation; identify document dates, named roles, missing pages or signatures, and items that may require attorney confirmation. Note that the 2018 documents name Lina Mossbutton as primary fiduciary and health care decision-maker and predate the marriage to Owen Cloudpuddle.
